verdict.rationale: The evidence only documents incident.io acting as an MCP *server* (docs-10, docs-29, docs-40, docs-47, probe-3) — i.e., other AI assistants can connect to incident.io's data — not incident.io acting as an MCP *client* that lets users plug external MCP servers into its own agents (e.g., Investigations, Scribe) to extend their tool use. No evidence anywhere describes configuring or attaching third-party MCP servers into incident.io's AI features. missing for 10: any documentation of incident.io consuming/connecting to external MCP servers as a client, configuration UI or API for adding MCP servers to its agents.
